description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different trigger words in terms of attack success rate (ASR) under the "SST-2, dirty-label, poison_num: 16" setting. The horizontal axis displays a series of trigger words—bb, mb, cf, beautiful, excellent, gorgeous, wonderful, brilliant, stunning, and beautifully—arranged in ascending order based on the ASR of the clean model. The vertical axis represents the ASR, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Three distinct lines represent the performance of different trigger types: "start" (green dashed line with circle markers), "random" (orange dashed line with cross markers), and "end" (purple dashed line with circle markers). The "start" line begins at an ASR of approximately 0.73 for the word "bb" and shows a general upward trend, peaking at around 0.93 for "beautifully." The "random" line starts at an ASR of approximately 0.13 for "bb" and increases steadily to about 0.85 for "beautifully." The "end" line starts at an ASR of approximately 0.41 for "bb," rises sharply to a peak of about 0.91 for "cf," then fluctuates, reaching a final value of approximately 0.91 for "beautifully." Overall, the "start" and "end" lines generally show higher ASR values compared to the "random" line across most trigger words.
